metadata.label: Example prompt
metadata.value:
PROMPT 1 — Initial creation request

$blender-create-model

Create a stylized boy getting ready for school, wearing a backpack and
adjusting one shoulder strap. Give him a friendly, alert expression,
deliberate character proportions, and readable hands and shoes.

Render style: comic-book illustration interpreted as editable 3D, with
simple graphic shapes, controlled bands of shading, and dark drawn details.
Setting: a simple cozy bedroom corner with a small bed, books, and a window.
Lighting: warm morning sunlight with enough fill to read the face clearly.
Palette: muted blue and warm yellow, with restrained warm wood and skin tones.
Camera: use the default clinical inspection view when no angle is specified:
centered, full-body orthographic three-quarter view with comfortable margins.

Use blender-setup, blender-materials, blender-light-camera, blender-render,
and blender-review-optimize as appropriate alongside blender-create-model.
Work through the verified official Blender Lab MCP in the open Blender app.
Preserve unrelated Blender content and create an isolated example scene.

Deliver:
- result.blend: editable scene with final camera, lighting, and materials.
- result.png: clean 1280x720 final camera Render Result, without any Blender UI.
- editor.png: genuine Blender editor screenshot of the completed scene.
- review.md: actual skills, settings, timings, checks, revisions, and limitations.

Use 640x360 previews and target under 30 seconds per still, as a goal rather
than a hard limit. Prefer EEVEE. Inspect the actual renders and reopen the
saved scene to check portability before presenting it for human approval.
This is a static character illustration; no rig or animation is requested.
No external image reference is supplied for this pilot; use the textual style.

Success criteria: clear complete silhouette; one hand visibly adjusting the
backpack strap; friendly readable face; recognizable bedroom context; warm
light without losing facial detail; no clipped head or feet; editable scene.

metadata.label: Example prompt
metadata.value:
PROMPT 1 - Initial creation request

$blender-create-environment

Create a realistic architectural visualization of a firehouse on a city
corner. Make it a detailed two-story red-brick station with two large
fire-engine bays, a pedestrian entrance, stone trim, metal apparatus doors,
reflective upper windows, a restrained station sign, and a hose-drying tower.
Include sidewalks, curbs, an intersection with crosswalks, streetlights,
a hydrant, and neighboring city buildings to establish the urban setting.

Use realistic proportions and physically based masonry, stone, concrete,
painted metal, asphalt, and glass. Add subtle surface texture and weathering.
Use natural daytime lighting, balanced exposure, and believable shadows.
Camera: clear architectural three-quarter perspective showing the front
and side of the station and its relationship to the street corner. Keep
the complete building visible and avoid excessive wide-angle distortion.

Use blender-setup, blender-procedural-geometry, blender-materials,
blender-light-camera, blender-render, and blender-review-optimize alongside
blender-create-environment. Keep repeated facade windows editable with
documented controls and verify those controls within sensible limits.
Preserve existing Blender content and use an isolated scene.

Deliver all generated files inside output/:
- result.blend: editable portable scene, camera, materials, lights, controls.
- result.png: clean final camera Render Result at 1280x720, no UI or HUD.
- editor.png: genuine Blender editor screenshot of the completed scene.
- review.md: settings, actual skills, measured timings, verification,
  corrective actions, assumptions, and remaining quality limitations.

Use 640x360 previews. Target less than 30 seconds per still as a goal,
not a hard limit. Benchmark EEVEE or GPU Cycles and use denoising when useful.
The result should read as realistic architecture, not a cartoon miniature.
No external image reference is required: this is an original fictional
firehouse, not a survey or reconstruction of a particular real building.
Verify the saved file by reopening it and inspect the actual output images.

Dense procedural scene uses per-corner baked colors to preserve foliage palettes without texture-atlas loss. Geometry is retained; sub-vertex color variation and procedural bump microdetail are not represented.
Lossless EXT_meshopt_compression; decoded vertex attributes and triangle topology verified unchanged. Requires Meshopt decoder.

metadata.label: Review
metadata.value: The user supplied `../input/sketch.png`. Its visible landmarks are a roughly square island, an open grassy clearing, nine perimeter trees mixing broadleaf and conifer silhouettes, a stream following one edge, fractured sides, and detached rock fragments.

metadata.label: Example prompt
metadata.value: Turn the supplied sketch into an editable 3D floating forest game island. Preserve its grassy clearing, perimeter trees, winding stream, and elevated three-quarter composition. Use stylized forms, realistic materials, and bright, vivid natural colors. Expose torn soil, fractured rock and roots underneath, with falling dirt and rock fragments. No skybox or ground below. Create a 2D visual target first, then deliver an editable Blender scene and a 1920×1080 PNG render.
